correctness.rationale: Generating-function coefficient extraction yields positive cosines for every odd degree and a total meridional coefficient exactly (ell(ell+1)-2)/2. Its endpoint support radius is sharp, and nonnegative meridional curvature forces nonnegative azimuthal curvature by a two-hemisphere integral argument. Known spherical-harmonic norm and Laplacian identities give the exact support-function volume quadratic; independent exact rational integrations for degrees 3,5,7,9 corroborate. Mode ordering and meridional zero sets follow from elementary strict monotonicity and simultaneous cosine equalities. The finite checker is not used as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Hynd gives support-function curvature constraints and an axial extremality theory, not the exact Legendre coefficient/latitude classification. Antunes–Bogosel already gives the 3D spherical-harmonic volume quadratic identity, so no claim is made to originate that identity. The new geometric ingredient is the exact all-odd-degree nonlinear convexity threshold from positive cosine coefficients; it yields the complete minimizer hierarchy and first-degree exceptional degeneracy. value.rationale: The exact all-degree nonlinear admissible interval is a useful spectral building-block classification for axially symmetric three-dimensional constant-width bodies, with a complete mode-wise sharp volume optimization and a qualitative change in degeneracy loci at the first nontranslation degree. Known spectral volume identities alone do not determine which amplitudes are convex, and computational polygonal approximations do not supply this infinite-degree classification. The theorem carefully excludes unrestricted Blaschke–Lebesgue optimization and mixtures.
